newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AHK ups some cargo rates by 5 pct on Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: AHK ups some cargo rates by 5 pct on Oct 1.

text.p: Air Hong Kong (AHK), said its ex-Europe air cargo rates to Dubai, Hong Kong and Japan will increase by an average of five percent, effective October 1.

"While the market has picked up since the end of August it is still well down on the same period last year so I suppose we're sticking our necks out a little," AHK's Brussels-based general manager Cargo, Marcel Buelens, told Reuters.
The increase in rates was part of a strategy to restore yields which have been eroded in 1996, Buelens said.

"For the first, seven months of the year, our revenues were down seven percent on 1995 levels and a long way short of our own targets. Our aim is to improve our average yield by five percent by the end of October in concentrating efforts on traffic from regular customers and limiting the volume of ad hoc business which has the impact of diluting revenues."

AHK operates scheduled Boeing 747-200F services between Brussels and Hong Kong. The company is 75 percent owned by Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
